text:
maria: quick sync — customer-managed-networking path for private deploys. want to nail packaging & upgrade contract before next field beta.
kevin_p: do you mean customers will own the network components (load balancer, NAT, ipam) and we only ship nodes? clarification pls.
maria: yes. they'd run their own LB/edge, our installer config would assume static routes + customer svc CIDRs. plan needs an explicit handshake for ip ranges, SNI certs, and upgrade windows.
sam: major constraint: some customers have strict change windows (monthly). we need a non-disruptive upgrade strategy + rollback plan.
jess: proposal: three modes — managed-network (we manage), customer-network-static (we push nodes, customer supplies LB/ips), customer-network-agent (lightweight agent to coordinate ip handshakes). which is MVP?
maria: MVP=customer-network-static. lowest infra change. deliverables: docs, installer flags, preflight checker, upgrade-notify webhook. also need clear failure-mode doc.
kevin_p: preflight checklist idea:
```
- LB reachable on port 443
- cert present or ACME enabled
- gateway routes for pod cidr
- control-plane reachable from ops network
```
sam: +1. for upgrades: implement rolling node upgrades with kubecordon + drain, and a 'quiesce' mode customers can opt into during window.
jess: launch criteria (must-have): preflight passes on three customer networks, upgrade tested on canary infra, rollback tested, docs + runbook ready.
maria: customer comms: add explicit SLA notes: if customer manages network we only guarantee node-level SLA, not end-to-end connectivity. legal will need to sign-off.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy-preview job for branch feature/customer-net-static at 2026-04-02T14:00Z
kevin_p: next steps: I'll scope packaging changes and add flag docs. @sam can you own upgrade choreography? @jess write launch checklist.
sam: will pick it up, posting rough timeline end of day.
jess: will draft the checklist and share in this thread by EOD :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — we'll review in Friday product sync. react with :eyes: if you saw this.
